title: Efficient greybox fuzzing framework with tabu search
task: Seed scheduling and energy allocation for fuzzing
key_results: 19.89% improvement in path exploration over AFL
160.87% improvement in crash discovery over AFL
comments: The tabu search formulation for seed scheduling is practical but the evaluation is limited to 9 programs; generalization to diverse software ecosystems remains unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tabu search seed scheduling outperforms coarse-grained heuristics in prioritizing high-quality seeds
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated 19.89% better path exploration than AFL

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive energy allocation based on fine-grained execution information improves crash detection
hypotheses.result: 160.87% improvement in crash discovery over AFL baseline

title: Specifics of the growth of lithium-doped KCl single crystals by the Bridgman method in an argon atmosphere
task: Purification and growth of lithium-doped KCl single crystals via Bridgman method
key_results: KCl matrix purified to 0.2 ppm oxygen-containing impurities, 0.1–0.3 ppm divalent impurities, 1–3 ppm alkali-metal cations; enhanced scintillation and dosimetric properties demonstrated in KCl:Li crystals
comments: The multi-stage purification approach (pyrolytic coating, high vacuum, argon shielding) is systematic, though the specific scintillation performance metrics are not quantified numerically.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pyrolytic carbon coating suppresses adhesion of molten AHC to ampoule walls
hypotheses.result: Successfully enabled crystal extraction and growth

hypotheses.hypothesis: High vacuum purification removes oxygen-containing impurities from raw materials
hypotheses.result: Achieved 0.2 ppm OH concentration in final crystal

title: Embedded sensing telemetry and a validated explicit finite element digital twin of pressurised uPVC pipe under low velocity impact
task: Validated digital twin of pressurized uPVC pipe response to low-velocity impact
key_results: Peak contact force increased 3527–4174 N with internal pressure rise (689–2068 kPa); permanent deformation decreased 15.1–7.0 mm; experimental and numerical plastic-zone areas agreed to 16.9%
comments: The synchronized ABAQUS/Explicit model provides confidence in predictive capability, though the study validates only a single impact scenario and discharge power at device scale was not tested.

inputs: 4 kg hammer at 5.56 m/s mid-span impact

hypotheses.hypothesis: Internal pressure induces wall stiffening, reducing permanent deformation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: deformation decreased from 15.1 to 7.0 mm as pressure rose

hypotheses.hypothesis: Contact-force response transitions from linear to plateau behavior near burst pressure
hypotheses.result: Observed linear response up to ~1379 kPa, then plateau onset

title: Thermal transport and crystallisation in octadecane composites with porous framework coatings and graphene
task: Enhanced thermal transport and crystallization control in phase-change material composites
key_results: ZIF-8-coated composite: thermal conductivity 0.78 ± 0.04 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹, supercooling 1.2 ± 0.2 °C; UiO-66-coated composite: 0.72 ± 0.03 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹, supercooling 2.4 ± 0.3 °C; ZIF-8 retained 98.2 ± 1.1% melting enthalpy after 1000 cycles
comments: The synergistic effect of metal–organic framework coating and graphene is demonstrated but not mechanistically isolated; device-scale discharge power validation is absent, limiting applicability assessment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Graphene nanoplatelets enhance thermal conductivity beyond either component alone
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: combined ZIF-8+graphene (0.78 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹) exceeds ZIF-8 alone or graphene alone

hypotheses.hypothesis: Metal–organic framework coatings delay crystallization via nucleation suppression
hypotheses.result: Partially supported: UiO-66 (2.4 °C supercooling) > ZIF-8 (1.2 °C); mechanism not isolated due to confounding coating parameters
